name: Greek Mythology Heroes
title: Greek Mythology Heroes
description: Heroic figures from ancient Greek mythology, including semi-divine mortals and legendary champions.

rows.name: Abderus
rows.description: aided Heracles during his eighth labour and was killed by the Mares of Diomedes

rows.name: Achilles
rows.description: hero of the Trojan War and a central character in Homer's Iliad

rows.name: Aeneas
rows.description: a hero of the Trojan War and progenitor of the Roman people

rows.name: Ajax the Great
rows.description: a hero of the Trojan War and king of Salamis

rows.name: Ajax the Lesser
rows.description: a hero of the Trojan War and leader of the Locrian army

rows.name: Amphitryon
rows.description: Theban general who rescued Thebes from the Teumessian fox; his wife was Alcmene, mother of Heracles

rows.name: Antilochus
rows.description: Son of Nestor sacrificed himself to save his father in the Trojan War along with other deeds of valor

rows.name: Bellerophon
rows.description: hero who slew the Chimera

rows.name: Castor
rows.description: the mortal Dioscuri twin; after Castor's death, his immortal brother Pollux shared his divinity with him in order that they might remain together

rows.name: Chrysippus
rows.description: a divine hero of Elis

rows.name: Daedalus
rows.description: creator of the labyrinth and great inventor, until King Minos trapped him in his own creation.

rows.name: Diomedes
rows.description: a king of Argos and hero of the Trojan War

rows.name: Eleusis
rows.description: eponymous hero of the town of Eleusis

rows.name: Eunostus
rows.description: a Boeotian hero

rows.name: Ganymede
rows.description: Trojan hero and lover of Zeus, who was given immortality and appointed cup-bearer to the gods

rows.name: Hector
rows.description: hero of the Trojan War and champion of the Trojan people

rows.name: Icarus
rows.description: the son of the master craftsman Daedalus

rows.name: Iolaus
rows.description: nephew of Heracles who aided his uncle in one of his Labors

rows.name: Jason
rows.description: leader of the Argonauts

rows.name: Meleager
rows.description: a hero who sailed with the Argonauts and killed the Calydonian Boar

rows.name: Odysseus
rows.description: a hero and king of Ithaca whose adventures are the subject of Homer's Odyssey; he also played a key role during the Trojan War

rows.name: Orpheus
rows.description: a legendary musician and poet who attempted to retrieve his dead wife from the Underworld

rows.name: Pandion
rows.description: the eponymous hero of the Attic tribe Pandionis, usually assumed to be one of the legendary Athenian kings Pandion I or Pandion II.

rows.name: Perseus
rows.description: son of Zeus and the founder-king of Mycenae and slayer of the Gorgon Medusa

rows.name: Theseus
rows.description: son of Poseidon and a king of Athens and slayer of the Minotaur
